sentences.text:
THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 05.03.2020, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C).No.1367 OF 2020(U)
 2  JUDGMENT
Pursuant to the interim order dated 30.01.2020 it is submitted that the directions in the impugned circular have been partially withdrawn.
It is stated that the direction with regard to supply of water from quarries has been retained and that the other directions have been appropriately modified.
It is submitted by the learned Government Pleader that information with regard to the decision will be issued by the District Administration without delay.
In the above view of the mater, I am of the opinion that the substantial reliefs sought for by the petitioner in the Writ Petition stand redressed.
The Writ Petition is accordingly closed.

Sd/-
